description.narrative: Founded in 2017, Association Spectra is a first and only trans-led organization in Montenegro, working on promotion and protection of human rights of transgender, gender diverse and intersex persons. Their mission is to eradicate gender-based violence in Montenegro through the creation of a strong, visible movement, advocacy, education and active involvement of trans, gender-diverse and intersex persons in the creation and implementation of policies that ensure equality and respect for diversity. The grant will support the following specific priorities: - Advancing TIGV inclusive, (Transgender, intersex and gender variant persons), gender equality and democracy in state policies and agendas - Supporting the development of services and adequate access to resources for TIGV persons (health care, education, social services, employment) - Supporting changes in public narratives on the topics of gender and sex, as well as the role and place of TIGV people in society - Strengthening the intersectional gender equality movement in the country and region - Actively empowering the TIGV community for political and civic participation
